# Grok Build CLI fixtures

These rows derive from the #115 controlled macOS arm64 capture of stable Grok Build CLI 1.0.77, build `50ca579fa996`. Two prompts completed in the same native session across explicit resume. The native update and snapshot keep their allowlisted accounting shapes and captured counts. IDs, hook names and timestamps are synthetic. The first snapshot end straddles a second with its matching completion. The headless projection retains only terminal turn identity and accounting fields. No prompt, model response, path, signing key or receipt signature is included.

Tests derive cancellation, rewind, copied history, forks, concurrent prompts, later appends and malformed or conflicting evidence from these rows. Those derivatives test refusals and verified boundaries. Native qualification belongs to M18 and M19.
